messages.content: Infer one typed physical-input ledger. Exact CSV names and explicit input order are binding. Return each input exactly once with its physical quantity name, a plain-language physical_definition, and all seven named SI exponents M,L,T,I,Theta,N,J as rational strings. Use null for unknown coordinates. For a base quantity known not to participate, explicitly return '0'; this is known absence, not uncertainty. Use null only when the exponent is genuinely unknown. Never infer unknown as0. Exclude the output and metadata/unused/derived columns. quantity_name and physical_definition are retrieval meaning fields: do not put assigned SI units, dimension vectors or exponent formulas there. Do not output a separate dimensional matrix or n/r/k. They are generated deterministically from this ledger. A confident name is not proof of its SI vector.

Problem statement:
Perform dimensional analysis for sand-grain roughness parameterization to derive the dimensionless relationship governing the normalized equivalent sand-grain roughness (denoted as ks/Ra).
This analysis uses ONLY the following 7 physical quantities as input parameters:
the first-order absolute moment of height fluctuations, Ra;
the peak-to-valley height, kt;
the root-mean-square height, k_rms;
the third central moment of roughness height fluctuations divided by the cube of their root-mean-square height, Sk;
the kurtosis of roughness height fluctuations, Ku;
the effective streamwise slope of the roughness, ES;
the surface porosity, Po.

CSV columns: ['Ra', 'kt', 'k_rms', 'Sk', 'Ku', 'ES', 'Po', 'ks', 'ks/Ra', 'case', 'case_id']
